title: Pistachio Crusted Tunny Steak with Tunisian Skillet
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish, combining the freshness of tuna with the warmth of Tunisia and the crunch of pistachios.
instructions: Season the tuna steaks with salt, black pepper, and tunisian spice blend.
In a shallow dish, mix pistachio meal and a pinch of salt.
Dip each tuna steak in the pistachio mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the tuna steaks for 1-2 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of your choice.
